`;
const cardHTML=await(async()=>{const b=atob(ORIGINAL),bytes=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)bytes[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);const stream=new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'));return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer())})();
// Preserve the ORIGINAL approved, embedded front/back pixel assets and layout.
// Surgical V6 patch runs only after the legacy gzip card is decoded, never replaces it with a new design.
function upgradeApprovedCard(original){
 let h=original;
 const change=(from,to,label)=>{if(!h.includes(from))throw new Error('原卡局部修复缺少锚点：'+label);h=h.replace(from,to)};
 change('</style>','.card,.side,.side img,.side canvas{border-radius:16px!important}.side{overflow:hidden!important}.side img,.side canvas{border-radius:14px!important}</style>','数字卡圆角');
 // The core is loaded inside the ORIGINAL card's srcdoc, before the legacy draw script runs.
 change('</head>','<script src="/pasture-preview/six-dim-core.js"><'+'/script></head>','六维模块');
 change("const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);const suits=", "const six=window.BudaoSix;if(!six||six.CAPACITY!==7488||six.PUBLIC_LIMIT!==7000)throw Error('六维生成器未就绪');const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);const suits=", '六维初始化');
 change("if(saved&&['guest','verified','draw1','draw2','active'].includes(saved.phase))state=saved;", "if(saved&&['guest','verified','draw1','draw2','active'].includes(saved.phase)){if((saved.first&&!saved.first.numberColor)||(saved.final&&!saved.final.numberColor)||(saved.phase==='active'&&!saved.final)){state={phase:'guest',first:null,final:null,usedSecond:false,seriesId:six.SERIES.id};try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}}else state=saved;}",'旧五维样机状态转换');
 h=h.replace(/const all=\[\];for\(const s of suits\)[\s\S]*?const demoPool=order\.slice\(0,3000\)\.map\(x=>x\.v\);/,
   "const all=Array.from({length:six.PUBLIC_LIMIT},(_,slot)=>{const v=six.decode(six.allottedCode(slot));return {...v,color:v.side}});const demoPool=all;");
 if(!h.includes('const demoPool=all;'))throw Error('旧五维卡池替换未通过');
 change("return [v.suit,v.rank,v.dice,v.color,v.piece].join(':')", "return [six.SERIES.id,v.suit,v.rank,v.numberColor,v.dice,v.side,v.piece].join(':')",'六维唯一键');
 change("return Math.floor(Math.random()*max)", "return six.randomInt(max)",'安全随机源');
 change("${v.rank}　/　${diceFaces[v.dice]}　/　${v.color==='white'?'白':'黑'}", "${v.rank}（${v.numberColor==='red'?'红字':'黑字'}）　/　${diceFaces[v.dice]}　/　${v.side==='white'?'白':'黑'}",'六维身份显示');
 change("DATA.print_rank_colors[v.suit]+'_'+v.rank", "v.numberColor+'_'+v.rank",'牌值颜色与花色脱钩');
 change("$('tupleReadout').classList.toggle('red',['heart','diamond'].includes(value.suit))", "$('tupleReadout').classList.toggle('red',value.numberColor==='red')",'身份显示颜色');
 if(!h.includes("{suit:'club',rank:'2',dice:4,color:'white',piece:'knight'}"))throw Error('原卡默认值锚点缺失');
 h=h.replaceAll("{suit:'club',rank:'2',dice:4,color:'white',piece:'knight'}", "{suit:'club',rank:'2',numberColor:'black',dice:4,color:'white',side:'white',piece:'knight'}");
 h=h.replaceAll("state={phase:'verified',first:null,final:null,usedSecond:false}", "state={phase:'verified',seriesId:six.SERIES.id,first:null,final:null,usedSecond:false}");
 // The example card remains visual reference only. Never restrict suits/number inks using its sample pairing.
 h=h.replaceAll('五维','六维').replaceAll('3,744','7,488').replaceAll('3,000','7,000').replaceAll('744 位','488 位');
 h=h.replace('4 × 13 × 6 × 2 × 6 =','4 × 13 × 2 × 6 × 2 × 6 =');
 h=h.replaceAll('DIGITAL PASTURE · BUDĀO CARD / 01','数字牧场 · 步道卡')
 .replaceAll('SECOND AND FINAL CHANCE','第二次 · 最后一次机会')
 .replaceAll('IDENTITY ACCESS / NOT ACTIVATED','身份尚未激活')
 .replaceAll('IDENTITY ACCESS / CODE VERIFIED','密钥已验证')
 .replaceAll('FIRST DRAW / MAKE YOUR CHOICE','第一次抽取 · 请选择')
 .replaceAll('SECOND DRAW / FINAL CARD','第二次抽取 · 自动确认')
 .replaceAll('OFFICIAL CARD / ACTIVATED','步道卡 · 已激活')
 .replaceAll('FIRST LAYER · DEMO','第一层 · 演示')
 .replaceAll('ACTIVATED · 7 / 7','已激活 · 七项功能');
 return h;
}
const approvedSixCardHTML=upgradeApprovedCard(cardHTML);
const $=x=>document.getElementById(x), main=$('liveArea'),card=$('cardIframe'), shade=$('cardShade');
const STORE='budao_pixel_card_activation_prototype_v1', UNLOCK='budao.card.activated.v1';
let lastPhase='guest', toastTimer=0, sourceLoaded=false, mirror=null;
try{mirror=localStorage.getItem(STORE)}catch(e){}
function readState(){let v;try{v=JSON.parse(mirror || localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'null')}catch(e){try{v=JSON.parse(mirror)}catch(_){}}if(!v||typeof v!=='object')return{phase:'guest'};if(v.phase==='active'&&(!v.final||!v.final.numberColor||!v.final.side||v.seriesId!=='CSCZ-001'))return{phase:'guest'};return v}
window.addEventListener('message',e=>{if(e.source!==card.contentWindow||!e.data||e.data.type!=='budao-integrated-store')return;if(e.data.key===STORE){mirror=e.data.value;try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,mirror)}catch(_){}syncState();}});
function shimScript(initial){const v=JSON.stringify(initial||null);return '<script>'+`(()=>{const memory={};if(${v}!==null)memory[${JSON.stringify(STORE)}]=${v};const store={getItem:k=>memory[k]??null,setItem:(k,value)=>{memory[k]=String(value);parent.postMessage({type:'budao-integrated-store',key:k,value:memory[k]},'*')},removeItem:k=>{delete memory[k]}};try{Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{configurable:true,value:store})}catch(e){}})();`+'<'+'/script>';}

function isActive(){return readState().phase==='active'}
function toast(msg){clearTimeout(toastTimer);$('toast').textContent=msg;$('toast').classList.add('show');toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').classList.remove('show'),3200)}
function syncState(){const p=readState().phase;$('phaseText').textContent=p==='active'?'已激活：七个按钮均可进入':p==='draw1'?'第 1 / 2 次已生成：可确认或放弃':p==='draw2'?'第 2 / 2 次正在揭晓：将自动确认':p==='verified'?'密钥有效：可开始第一次抽取':'未激活：先领取步道卡';
  if(p==='active'){try{localStorage.setItem(UNLOCK,'1')}catch(e){};try{const d=main.contentDocument;if(d){const dot=d.getElementById('budaoCardDot');dot?.classList.add('active');}}catch(e){}}
  if(p!==lastPhase){lastPhase=p;if(p==='active')toast('身份已确认。现在可以进入已经设计好的功能板块。')}
}
const cardOnlyStyle=`<style>.pasture,.mast,.farm-shell,#resetDemo{display:none!important}.overlay{visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;pointer-events:auto!important;background:transparent!important;padding:3px!important}.window{max-height:calc(100dvh - 14px)!important;box-shadow:7px 8px #0005!important}.window-body{padding-top:18px!important}#exit{display:none!important}body{background:transparent!important}</style>`;
const cardDoc=approvedSixCardHTML.replace('</head>',cardOnlyStyle+shimScript(mirror)+'</head>');
card.addEventListener('load',()=>{try{const doc=card.contentDocument;doc?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('#closeActivated'))setTimeout(hideCard,45)},true)}catch(e){};syncState()});card.srcdoc=cardDoc;
function showCard(){shade.classList.add('open');$('topExit').style.display='block';try{const d=card.contentDocument;d?.getElementById('overlay')?.classList.add('show');d?.getElementById('card')?.focus()}catch(e){};syncState()}
function hideCard(){shade.classList.remove('open');$('topExit').style.display='none';try{const w=card.contentWindow,d=card.contentDocument;d?.getElementById('previewAuto')?.textContent?.includes('暂停')&&d.getElementById('previewAuto').click();}catch(e){};syncState()}
$('floatingCard').onclick=showCard;$('offlineCard').onclick=showCard;$('topExit').onclick=hideCard;shade.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===shade)hideCard()});
$('reset').onclick=()=>{if(!confirm('只清除这份审看样机的本地激活状态，不影响 budao.org，也不是正式产品的功能。是否继续？'))return;try{localStorage.removeItem(STORE);localStorage.removeItem(UNLOCK)}catch(e){}location.reload()};
function injectFeature(source){
  // Do not replace the previously made parchment / wind / grape / mailbox panels.
  // The older card module alone is suppressed; the new approved pixel card is opened by parent.
  source=source.replace('<iframe class="scene" src="./tonglu-pasture-v20.html"','<iframe class="scene" src="https://budao.org/tonglu.html"');
  source=source.replace('</head>','<style>.environment-layer{display:none!important}.budao-card-layer{display:none!important}body.budao-card-open .budao-card-layer{display:none!important}</style>'+shimScript(null)+'</head>');
  const oldCardStart=source.indexOf('<section class="budao-card-layer"');if(oldCardStart>=0){const oldCardEnd=source.indexOf('</section>',oldCardStart);if(oldCardEnd>=0)source=source.slice(0,oldCardStart)+source.slice(oldCardEnd+10)}
  const keyStart=source.lastIndexOf('<script>\n(() => {\n  const KEY=\'budao.card.activated.v1\';');
  if(keyStart>=0){const keyEnd=source.indexOf('<'+'/script>',keyStart);if(keyEnd>=0)source=source.slice(0,keyStart)+source.slice(keyEnd+9)}
  main.srcdoc=source;
}
main.addEventListener('load',()=>{
  const d=main.contentDocument;if(!d)return;
  const open=d.getElementById('budaoCardBtn');
  open?.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();showCard()},true);
  // Already-designed modules preserve their original event handlers. The new gate only precedes them.
  const protectedIds=['returnNow','grassBookBtn','windNewsBtn','partnersBtn','mailBtn'];
  protectedIds.forEach(id=>{const el=d.getElementById(id);el?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(isActive())return;e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();showCard();toast('请先激活属于你的步道卡，开启全部功能。')},true)});
  // Only the former 小匣 entrance is changed, retaining every other approved module.
  const shopTrigger=[...d.querySelectorAll('.pbtn')].find(el=>el.textContent.includes('小匣')||el.textContent.includes('小铺'));
  window.PastureShop?.attach(shopTrigger,{isActive,showCard,toast});
  window.PastureBox?.attach(d.getElementById('boxEntryBtn'),{isActive,showCard,toast});
  $('offline').style.display='none';main.classList.add('ready');sourceLoaded=true;syncState();
});
async function loadFeature(){const branch='feature/tonglu-pixel-pasture-v1';
const links=[
 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tonykao1/budao.org/'+branch+'/tonglu-function-zone-preview.html',
 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Tonykao1/budao.org@'+branch+'/tonglu-function-zone-preview.html'
 ];
 let problem='';for(const u of links){try{let ctrl=new AbortController();let t=setTimeout(()=>ctrl.abort(),11000);const r=await fetch(u,{cache:'no-store',signal:ctrl.signal});clearTimeout(t);if(!r.ok)throw new Error('HTTP '+r.status);let h=await r.text();if(!h.includes('grassBookBtn')||!h.includes('partnersBtn'))throw new Error('源文件不符合');injectFeature(h);return;}catch(e){problem=String(e)}}
 $('loadStatus').textContent='功能区在线源文件暂时无法读取（'+problem+'）。步道卡仍可单独体验；连接网络后刷新即可载入原有板块。';}
setInterval(syncState,350);syncState();loadFeature();document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&shade.classList.contains('open'))hideCard()});
})();
</script>
<section id="shopShade" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="牧场小铺" aria-hidden="true">
 <div id="shopWindow">
  <header class="shopCap"><span>✦　同 路 原 野 / 牧 场 小 铺</span><div class="capRight"><span id="shopBadge">七之七 · 审看版</span><button id="shopClose" type="button" aria-label="收起小铺">收起 ×</button></div></header>
  <canvas id="shopArt" width="480" height="90" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <nav id="shopNav" aria-label="小铺功能区">
   <button type="button" data-shop-tab="home" aria-selected="true">小铺</button>
   <button type="button" data-shop-tab="transfer" aria-selected="false">流转</button>
   <button type="button" data-shop-tab="goods" aria-selected="false">好物</button>
   <button type="button" data-shop-tab="support" aria-selected="false">支持</button>
  </nav>
  <div id="shopBody" tabindex="0"></div>
  <footer class="shopFoot"><span>有来有往，各得其益 · 商品销售与自由奉献分开记录</span><span>交互概念版 · 不发起真实订单 / 支付 / 奉献</span></footer>
  <div id="shopMsg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="shopDialog" id="shopDialog" aria-hidden="true"><div class="dialogPaper" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><h3 id="shopDialogTitle">登记意向</h3><p id="shopDialogDesc"></p><label for="shopDialogNote">给步道留一句话（非必填）</label><textarea id="shopDialogNote" maxlength="180" placeholder="例如：我希望在下一次步道活动中领取……"></textarea><div class="dialogBtns"><button id="shopDialogCancel" type="button">返回</button><button id="shopDialogConfirm" class="submit" type="button">提交演示意向</button></div></div></div>
 </div>
</section>

<script>
(()=>{
 const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),shade=$('shopShade'),body=$('shopBody'),msg=$('shopMsg'),modal=$('shopDialog');
 const products=[
 {id:'book',type:'可送',name:'一本山野读物',desc:'闲置读物，希望遇见下一位读者。',icon:'▤'},
 {id:'bag',type:'可换',name:'旧帆布袋',desc:'希望交换一本适合儿童的故事书。',icon:'▥'},
 {id:'pole',type:'想要',name:'儿童徒步杖',desc:'寻找适合小朋友的闲置徒步杖。',icon:'╱'},
 {id:'post',type:'可送',name:'几张旧明信片',desc:'把曾走过的地方送给同行的人。',icon:'▣'},
 {id:'mug',type:'可换',name:'随行杯',desc:'交换一件适合山间聚餐的小物。',icon:'▨'},
 {id:'cap',type:'可送',name:'遮阳帽',desc:'整理好的旧物，愿意继续被使用。',icon:'▰'}
 ];
 const goods=[
 {id:'stamp',name:'大龙票纪念贴纸',desc:'从步道邀请函延伸的收藏小物。',icon:'▧'},
 {id:'route',name:'七道菜路线明信片',desc:'把走过的路留在纸上。',icon:'▤'},
 {id:'badge',name:'步道徽章',desc:'小小一枚，常常同行。',icon:'◆'},
 {id:'bag',name:'同行布袋',desc:'适合装书，也适合装山路上的发现。',icon:'▥'}
 ];
 let tab='home',filter='全部',intentList=[],applications=[],isReview=false,dialogItem=null,msgTimer=0;
 function toast(s){clearTimeout(msgTimer);msg.textContent=s;msg.classList.add('on');msgTimer=setTimeout(()=>msg.classList.remove('on'),3100)}
 function h(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,x=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[x]))}
 function renderHome(){body.innerHTML=`<div class="shopPanelRow"><div><span class="shopTag tagGreen">牧场里的第七间屋子</span><h2>小铺</h2><p class="lead">带来一件，带走一件；或者为步道的下一程添一点柴火。这里不以拥有多少定义一个人，而是让好东西继续流转。</p></div><span class="miniSummary">有来 · 有往 · 各得其益</span></div>
 <div class="shopTiles">
 <button class="tile" data-go="transfer" type="button"><div class="tileArt">⇄</div><div class="tileInfo"><b>流转</b><small>可送 · 可换 · 想要<br>易彼益初代，线下交接</small></div></button>
 <button class="tile" data-go="goods" type="button"><div class="tileArt">▣</div><div class="tileInfo"><b>好物</b><small>步道纪念品与自制好物<br>让制作反哺步道事工</small></div></button>
 <button class="tile" data-go="support" type="button"><div class="tileArt">♡</div><div class="tileInfo"><b>支持</b><small>自由奉献，量力同行<br>不公开金额，不设排名</small></div></button></div>
 <div class="paperNote"><b>小铺的运行原则：</b>交换不是商品买卖；好物销售与自愿奉献分别记账。首版所有按钮仅供体验，不创建真实订单，也不进行收款。</div>`;}
 function renderTransfer(){const list=products.filter(x=>filter==='全部'||x.type===filter);body.innerHTML=`<div class="shopPanelRow"><div><span class="shopTag">易 → 彼 → 益</span><h2>流转</h2><p class="lead">初代由步道统一发布物品；已激活的同行者提出申请，最终由步道确认承接者，并在真实步道活动中完成交接。以后可继续流转。</p></div><span class="miniSummary">我的演示申请：${applications.length}</span></div>
 <div class="stepStrip"><span><b>易</b> · 步道发布</span><span><b>彼</b> · 登记申请，步道确认</span><span><b>益</b> · 步道活动当面交接并记录</span></div>
 <div class="filterRow">${['全部','可送','可换','想要'].map(x=>`<button type="button" data-filter="${x}" aria-pressed="${x===filter}">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div>
 <div class="products">${list.map(x=>`<article class="item"><figure><span aria-hidden="true">${x.icon}</span></figure><div class="itemInfo"><span class="shopTag ${x.type==='可送'?'tagGreen':x.type==='想要'?'tagRed':''}">${x.type}</span><strong>${h(x.name)}</strong><small>${h(x.desc)}<br>步道发布 · 展示样品</small><div class="itemActions"><small>不标价 · 不配送</small><button class="woodBtn" type="button" data-apply="${x.id}">${x.type==='可换'?'提出交换':x.type==='想要'?'回应资源':'申请承接'}</button></div></div></article>`).join('')}</div>
 ${applications.length?`<div class="paperNote">你的演示申请：${applications.map(x=>h(x)).join('、')}。状态：<b>待步道确认</b>。申请并不等于已获得物品。</div>`:''}`;}
 function renderGoods(){body.innerHTML=`<div class="shopPanelRow"><div><span class="shopTag tagGreen">步道制作 · 纪念小物</span><h2>好物</h2><p class="lead">少而精，不以促销为目的。销售净收益可用于支持步道持续开展。正式商品的价格、库存、成本和收益说明尚待确定。</p></div><span class="miniSummary">意向清单 ${intentList.length} 件</span></div>
 <div class="products" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr))">${goods.map(x=>`<article class="item"><figure><span aria-hidden="true">${x.icon}</span></figure><div class="itemInfo"><span class="shopTag">概念陈列 · 待定价</span><strong>${h(x.name)}</strong><small>${h(x.desc)}</small><div class="itemActions"><small>尚未销售</small><button class="woodBtn ${intentList.includes(x.id)?'light':''}" type="button" data-intent="${x.id}">${intentList.includes(x.id)?'从意向移除':'加入意向单'}</button></div></div></article>`).join('')}</div>
 <div class="paperNote"><b>意向清单：</b>${intentList.length?intentList.map(x=>h(goods.find(y=>y.id===x).name)).join('、')+'。':'暂时为空。'}<br>本版仅展示选品与商品区布局，没有真实购物车、订单或支付操作。</div>`;}
 function renderSupport(){body.innerHTML=`<div class="shopPanelRow"><div><span class="shopTag tagGreen">自由同行 · 非商品交易</span><h2>支持</h2><p class="lead">让下一段路，继续有人同行。自由奉献是个人自愿的决定，不与商城消费、身份资格、抽卡结果或物品申请绑定。</p></div><span class="miniSummary">不公开金额</span></div>
 <div class="supportPaper"><div class="paperFront"><h3>为下一段路添一点柴火</h3><p class="lead">你的金额只应在自己的支付确认及凭证中显示，不出现在公开界面或排名中。</p><label>希望支持的方向（演示）</label><div class="supportChoices"><label><input type="radio" name="shopPurpose" value="不限定用途" checked> 不限定用途</label><label><input type="radio" name="shopPurpose" value="路线活动"> 路线活动</label><label><input type="radio" name="shopPurpose" value="材料制作"> 材料制作</label></div><label for="supportAmt">填写自由金额（仅用于交互体验）</label><input type="number" id="supportAmt" min="1" max="999999" step="1" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="你决定自己的金额" autocomplete="off"><p style="font-size:11px;color:#747a69;margin-top:6px">此输入框不提交真实交易，也不会生成收款二维码。</p><button class="woodBtn" id="supportConfirm" type="button">查看奉献确认示意 →</button></div>
 <aside class="privacy"><h3>像一只安静的奉献袋</h3><p>不展示别人的金额，不设置排行榜，不以奉献多少区分同行者。</p><p>正式上线前，必须明确真实收款主体、支付渠道、用途和对账方式。</p><p><b>商品销售款 / 自愿奉献款，分开记录。</b></p><span class="shopTag">目前未接入收款</span></aside></div>`;}
 function render(){[...$('shopNav').querySelectorAll('button')].forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(b.dataset.shopTab===tab))); body.scrollTop=0; ({home:renderHome,transfer:renderTransfer,goods:renderGoods,support:renderSupport}[tab])();}
 function go(t){tab=t;render()}
 function open(review=false){isReview=review;shade.classList.add('open');shade.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');$('shopBadge').textContent=review?'直接审看 · 身份门槛未变':'已激活 · 同行小铺';go('home');$('shopClose').focus()}
 function close(){shade.classList.remove('open');shade.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');closeModal();}
 function openModal(x){dialogItem=x;$('shopDialogTitle').textContent=x.type==='想要'?'我有这件资源':x.type==='可换'?'提出交换':'申请承接';$('shopDialogDesc').textContent='「'+x.name+'」——此处仅展示申请流程。真实提交须拥有正式步道卡，是否承接由步道最终确认，物品在步道活动中交接。';$('shopDialogNote').value='';modal.classList.add('on');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');$('shopDialogNote').focus()}
 function closeModal(){modal.classList.remove('on');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');dialogItem=null}
 $('shopClose').onclick=close;
 $('shopNav').onclick=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-shop-tab]');if(t)go(t.dataset.shopTab)};
 body.onclick=e=>{
  const t=e.target.closest('[data-go]');if(t){go(t.dataset.go);return}
  const f=e.target.closest('[data-filter]');if(f){filter=f.dataset.filter;render();return}
  const a=e.target.closest('[data-apply]');if(a){const x=products.find(v=>v.id===a.dataset.apply);if(x)openModal(x);return}
  const i=e.target.closest('[data-intent]');if(i){const id=i.dataset.intent;intentList=intentList.includes(id)?intentList.filter(x=>x!==id):[...intentList,id];render();toast(intentList.includes(id)?'已加入本次意向清单（演示）':'已从意向清单移除');return}
  if(e.target.id==='supportConfirm'){
   const amt=$('supportAmt').value, num=Number(amt);
   if(!amt||!Number.isFinite(num)||num<=0){toast('请输入大于零的金额，仅用于预览。');return}
   const purpose=body.querySelector('input[name=shopPurpose]:checked')?.value||'不限定用途';
   toast('确认示意：'+purpose+'；本人输入的金额 ￥'+Number(num).toFixed(2)+'。未发起收款，未保存奉献记录。');
  }
 };
 $('shopDialogCancel').onclick=closeModal;
 $('shopDialogConfirm').onclick=()=>{if(!dialogItem)return;const id=dialogItem.id;const label=dialogItem.name;applications.push(label);closeModal();render();toast('「'+label+'」申请示意已记录在本次页面中，待步道确认；并未实际提交。')};
 modal.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===modal)closeModal()};
 document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){if(modal.classList.contains('on'))closeModal();else if(shade.classList.contains('open'))close()}});
 function attach(el,{isActive,showCard,toast:outerToast}){
  if(!el||el.dataset.shopLinked)return;el.dataset.shopLinked='1';
  const svg='<span class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M2 7h12v7H2z" fill="#f1ddb0" stroke="#234e67" stroke-width="1"/><path d="M1 6l2-4h10l2 4-2 2-2-2-3 2-3-2-2 2z" fill="#b97854" stroke="#234e67" stroke-width="1"/><rect x="4" y="9" width="3" height="5" fill="#799b71"/><rect x="9" y="9" width="3" height="3" fill="#d8f1df"/></svg></span>';
  el.innerHTML=svg+'小铺';el.classList.add('clickable');el.setAttribute('role','button');el.setAttribute('tabindex','0');el.setAttribute('aria-label','打开小铺');
  const click=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();if(!isActive()){showCard();outerToast('请先领取并激活属于你的步道卡，才能进入小铺。');return}open(false)};
  el.addEventListener('click',click,true);
  el.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();click(e)}},true);
 }
 function drawArt(){
  const cv=$('shopArt'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d');ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  const R=(x,y,w,h,c)=>{ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(x,y,w,h)};
  const P=(a,c)=>{ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(...a[0]);a.slice(1).forEach(p=>ctx.lineTo(...p));ctx.closePath();ctx.fill()};
  R(0,0,480,90,'#a2cdd0');R(0,51,480,39,'#90c478');R(0,63,480,27,'#6aa361');
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){let x=(i*73+12)%475;R(x,7+(i%3)*6,18,3,'#f7f2df');R(x+5,4+(i%3)*6,10,4,'#f7f2df')}
  P([[0,53],[40,29],[69,45],[106,22],[145,48],[188,25],[244,47],[302,26],[353,48],[417,28],[480,51]],'#6d9ea5');
  P([[0,58],[45,41],[80,54],[132,41],[180,56],[228,38],[280,54],[331,39],[382,54],[442,41],[480,54]],'#7ea77c');
  // pixel shop in the center
  R(114,33,248,47,'#78533d');R(118,36,240,41,'#b98557');R(107,28,263,7,'#61473a');R(116,23,245,7,'#84513e');R(129,17,217,7,'#a46346');R(145,12,185,6,'#bd8055');
  R(200,22,76,18,'#ead9ab');R(204,26,68,10,'#3d6456');ctx.fillStyle='#fff8dc';ctx.font='bold 10px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('小 铺',238,35);
  R(124,46,66,24,'#e9dfb9');R(132,49,8,16,'#7b986d');R(143,46,10,19,'#b97d50');R(157,49,7,16,'#63826c');R(170,49,10,15,'#d4b16c');R(124,71,66,4,'#674738');
  R(202,44,70,32,'#76523e');R(209,49,56,5,'#e4bd7d');R(215,57,12,14,'#f4e5bb');R(229,58,12,13,'#b77c5b');R(243,57,13,14,'#7d9360');
  R(284,46,65,24,'#eadfb9');R(292,52,19,16,'#c38962');R(298,48,7,4,'#d1aa7b');R(319,56,13,10,'#567d65');R(317,53,17,3,'#be985e');R(284,71,65,4,'#674738');
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){R(i*61+16,67+(i%3)*7,2,3,'#c9d591');R(i*57+10,73+(i%2)*4,4,1,'#42694a')}
  R(99,77,282,6,'#65503b');R(0,85,480,5,'#527e4e');
 }
 drawArt();render();
 window.PastureShop={open,close,attach};
 $('floatingShop').onclick=()=>open(true);
 $('offlineShop').onclick=()=>open(true);
})()
</script>

<!-- Private settings drawer: accessible through identity avatar card, outside seven main actions. -->
<section id="boxShade" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="小匣 · 私人设置" aria-hidden="true">
 <div id="boxWindow">
  <header class="boxTop"><span>▣　同 路 原 野　/　PRIVATE DRAWER</span><button id="boxClose" type="button" aria-label="收起小匣">收起 ×</button></header>
  <canvas id="boxArt" width="480" height="96" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
  <div id="boxBodyGrid">
   <aside id="boxAside"><span class="boxMark">ONE SMALL PLACE FOR YOURSELF</span><h2>小匣</h2><p class="asideNote">把名字、使用习惯，以及想保留的边界，安静地放在这里。</p>
    <nav id="boxTabs" aria-label="小匣内容">
      <button type="button" data-boxtab="name" aria-selected="true">▤　我的名牌</button>
      <button type="button" data-boxtab="prefs" aria-selected="false">✧　使用习惯</button>
      <button type="button" data-boxtab="about" aria-selected="false">▥　关于小匣</button>
    </nav><div class="tiny">不额外占用第八个主按钮。<br>身份唯一，习惯自由。</div>
   </aside>
   <main id="boxContent" tabindex="0" aria-live="polite"></main>
  </div>
  <footer class="boxBottom"><span>小匣不存放激活密钥 · 不改变你的五维身份</span><span>数字牧场 / 第一版交互审看</span></footer>
  <div id="boxToast" role="status"></div>
 </div>
</section>

<script>
(()=>{
'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), shade=$('boxShade'),win=$('boxWindow'),content=$('boxContent');
const KEY='budao_pasture_box_prefs_preview_v1', CARDKEY='budao_pixel_card_activation_prototype_v1';
const DEFAULTS={nickname:'Tony',quiet:false,private:false,hints:true};
function readPrefs(){try{const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||'null');return {...DEFAULTS,...(v&&typeof v==='object'?v:{})}}catch(e){return {...DEFAULTS}}}
let prefs=readPrefs(),tab='name',noticeTimer=0,lastFocused=null;
function cardState(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CARDKEY)||'null')||{phase:'guest'}}catch(e){return{phase:'guest'}}}
function isActive(){return cardState().phase==='active'}
function code(v){if(!v)return '';const ss={spade:'♠',heart:'♥',club:'♣',diamond:'♦'}, dd=['','⚀','⚁','⚂','⚃','⚄','⚅'],pc={king:'王',queen:'后',rook:'车',bishop:'象',knight:'马',pawn:'兵'};return `${ss[v.suit]||v.suit} · ${v.rank}${v.numberColor?('（'+(v.numberColor==='red'?'红字':'黑字')+'）'):''} · ${dd[v.dice]||v.dice} · ${(v.side||v.color)==='white'?'白方':'黑方'} · ${pc[v.piece]||v.piece}`}
function h(v){return String(v).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function notify(v){clearTimeout(noticeTimer);$('boxToast').textContent=v;$('boxToast').classList.add('show');noticeTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('boxToast').classList.remove('show'),2400)}
function persist(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(prefs))}catch(e){};applyPrefs()}
function applyPrefs(){
 win.classList.toggle('box-quiet',prefs.quiet);$('help').style.display=prefs.hints?'':'none';
 try{const d=$('liveArea').contentDocument;if(d){
    let st=d.getElementById('boxPreviewQuietStyle');if(!st){st=d.createElement('style');st.id='boxPreviewQuietStyle';st.textContent='html.box-ui-reduced .sky-ui,html.box-ui-reduced .pbtn{transition:none!important}html.box-ui-reduced .pixel:before,html.box-ui-reduced .pixel:after{animation:none!important}';d.head.appendChild(st)}
    d.documentElement.classList.toggle('box-ui-reduced',prefs.quiet);
    const name=d.querySelector('.identity .idtext .name');if(name)name.textContent=prefs.private?'同行者':prefs.nickname;
    const bid=d.querySelector('.identity .idtext .bid');if(bid)bid.textContent=prefs.private?'身份已隐去':isActive()?code(cardState().final):'五维身份待领取';
 }}catch(e){}
}
function render(){
 [...$('boxTabs').querySelectorAll('button')].forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(b.dataset.boxtab===tab)));
 const active=isActive(), actual=code(cardState().final);
 if(tab==='name'){
 content.innerHTML=`<div class="miniHead">01 / NAME PLATE</div><h3>我的名牌</h3><p class="intro">这里是你的随身收纳格。显示名称可以修改，已经领取的步道卡身份不可改动。</p>
  <div class="paper"><div class="miniHead">DISPLAY NAME / 显示名称</div><label for="boxNickname">希望牧场怎样称呼你？</label><input id="boxNickname" type="text" maxlength="12" autocomplete="nickname" value="${h(prefs.nickname)}" aria-label="显示名称"/><div class="actions"><button class="boxBtn" id="boxSaveName" type="button">收好这个名字</button><span class="sub">最多 12 字 · 本地预览保存</span></div></div>
  <div class="paper"><div class="miniHead">MY BUDAO CARD / 我的步道卡</div><span class="pill ${active?'':'wait'}">${active?'✓ 已激活':'○ 尚未领取'}</span><p class="codeLine" id="boxIdentityCode" style="margin:12px 0 0">${active?(prefs.private?'● ● ● ● ●':h(actual)):'待领取的五维身份'}</p><p class="sub">${active?'这是步道卡五维组合本身，没有第二套卡片 ID。':'完成密钥验证与至多两次随机抽取之后，这里才会出现你的唯一五维组合。'}</p><div class="actions"><button class="boxBtn" id="boxGoCard" type="button">${active?'查看我的步道卡':'去领取步道卡'} →</button>${active&&!prefs.private?'<button class="boxBtn ghost" id="boxCopyCode" type="button">复制五维编码</button>':''}</div></div>`;
  $('boxSaveName').onclick=()=>{let value=$('boxNickname').value.trim().slice(0,12);if(!value){notify('请先填写一个显示名称。');return;}prefs.nickname=value;persist();notify('名字已放入小匣（仅本机预览）。')};
  $('boxGoCard').onclick=()=>{close();document.getElementById('floatingCard').click()};
  if($('boxCopyCode'))$('boxCopyCode').onclick=()=>{const data=actual;const fallback=()=>{const t=document.createElement('textarea');t.value=data;document.body.appendChild(t);t.select();try{document.execCommand('copy');notify('五维编码已复制。')}catch(e){notify('复制失败，请直接查看卡面。')}t.remove()};if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText)navigator.clipboard.writeText(data).then(()=>notify('五维编码已复制。'),fallback);else fallback()};
 }else if(tab==='prefs'){
 const options=[['quiet','减少界面动效','减轻弹层和按钮的过渡动画，不修改羊群与天气的运行。'],['private','名牌隐私显示','在身份栏与小匣概览中隐去昵称、五维摘要；卡片本身仍可本人查看。'],['hints','显示审看提示','显示左上角的阶段与操作提示；正式网站不会使用这条演示提示。']];
 content.innerHTML=`<div class="miniHead">02 / PREFERENCES</div><h3>使用习惯</h3><p class="intro">只管理这个界面怎样陪伴你，不改变已经生成的身份，也不公开你的选择。</p><div class="paper">${options.map(([key,label,desc])=>`<div class="option"><div><b>${label}</b><small>${desc}</small></div><button type="button" class="toggle" data-pref="${key}" aria-pressed="${!!prefs[key]}">${prefs[key]?'开启 ON':'关闭 OFF'}</button></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="warn">这些偏好在此预览中保存在当前浏览器；未来正式接入账户时，才考虑跨设备同步。</div>`;
 content.querySelectorAll('[data-pref]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let key=b.dataset.pref;prefs[key]=!prefs[key];persist();render();notify('设置已保存（仅本机预览）。')});
 }else{
 content.innerHTML=`<div class="miniHead">03 / ABOUT THE DRAWER</div><h3>留一格给自己</h3><p class="intro">小匣藏在身份信息旁，不占据七大主功能按钮，也不与小铺混为一体。</p>
 <div class="paper"><div class="miniHead">SIMPLE BY DESIGN / 留在这里的</div><p style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;margin:0">显示名称、界面动效偏好、名牌隐私显示、操作提示。这些是可以重新调整的个人习惯。</p></div>
 <div class="paper"><div class="miniHead">WHAT STAYS / 不放在这里的</div><p style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;margin:0">激活密钥、支付信息、奉献金额、交换交易，以及重新抽取步道卡的按钮。五维身份一旦确定，不因清理小匣而改变。</p></div>
 <div class="warn"><b>预览状态：</b>仅本机界面演示。这里不具备服务器账户同步、正式退出登录或删除云端数据的功能。</div>
 <div class="actions"><button id="boxResetPrefs" type="button" class="boxBtn ghost">恢复小匣的默认偏好</button><button id="boxFold" type="button" class="boxBtn">收起小匣</button></div>`;
 $('boxResetPrefs').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('只重置小匣的显示名称和界面偏好。不会清除或重抽步道卡。继续吗？')){prefs={...DEFAULTS};persist();render();notify('小匣偏好已恢复默认；步道卡没有改变。')}};
 $('boxFold').onclick=close;
 }
}
function open(review=false){lastFocused=document.activeElement;tab='name';shade.classList.add('open');shade.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');win.dataset.preview=String(review);applyPrefs();render();$('boxClose').focus()}
function close(){shade.classList.remove('open');shade.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');lastFocused?.focus?.()}
function attach(b,{isActive:activeCheck,showCard,toast}){
 if(!b||b.dataset.boxAttached)return;b.dataset.boxAttached='1';
 // Use the eighth full-size grid entry directly; never add an overlay to identity.
 b.setAttribute('aria-label','打开小匣，个人与显示设置');b.title='打开私人小匣';
 b.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();if(!activeCheck()){showCard();toast('先领取步道卡，小匣随后为你打开。');return}open(false)},true);
 b.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();b.click()}},true);applyPrefs();
}
function paint(){const cv=$('boxArt'),c=cv.getContext('2d');c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;const R=(x,y,w,h,color)=>{c.fillStyle=color;c.fillRect(x,y,w,h)},P=(pts,col)=>{c.beginPath();c.moveTo(...pts[0]);for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)c.lineTo(...pts[i]);c.closePath();c.fillStyle=col;c.fill()};
 R(0,0,480,96,'#b3d6cb');R(0,32,480,64,'#8bbf9e');R(0,65,480,31,'#7ba47d');for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const x=16+i*77;R(x,11+(i%3)*6,23,4,'#eff0d3');R(x+5,8+(i%3)*6,13,3,'#eff0d3')}
 P([[0,56],[48,30],[86,52],[136,25],[180,49],[226,30],[289,55],[356,26],[403,47],[480,27],[480,80],[0,80]],'#7ea69b');
 // timber shelves left and right, wooden chest with an open lid in the center
 R(27,55,100,26,'#69533c');R(32,48,88,8,'#997148');R(37,54,11,16,'#d8bd80');R(53,54,18,16,'#9fbd84');R(79,55,13,16,'#e5d6a9');R(99,53,10,18,'#bd8e66');R(27,77,100,5,'#4d4336');
 R(347,55,102,25,'#69533c');R(352,48,93,8,'#987447');R(361,51,19,22,'#d0bd8c');R(383,55,16,17,'#709b82');R(408,51,12,23,'#cf9b66');R(347,77,102,5,'#4d4336');
 // chest open lid, pixel hinges, parchment sticking out
 P([[167,24],[300,24],[309,37],[159,37]],'#493c31');P([[171,25],[295,25],[302,34],[164,34]],'#b08a53');R(183,13,25,22,'#fbebbf');R(208,9,44,24,'#fff1cb');R(239,17,31,15,'#f7dba5');R(205,12,4,10,'#c5a46e');R(218,15,21,2,'#bd9d70');
 R(165,39,143,42,'#4f3e31');R(171,43,132,32,'#a87c4f');R(175,45,126,27,'#c69a62');R(168,39,138,5,'#77573e');R(168,74,138,6,'#745137');R(180,51,116,3,'#d5ad70');R(180,64,116,2,'#966c44');R(229,48,18,20,'#6e5436');R(233,51,10,13,'#e5cb84');R(236,53,4,7,'#8c7047');
 for(let x=171;x<305;x+=25){R(x,43,3,31,'#805c3e')}R(0,82,480,14,'#7f9467');for(let i=0;i<14;i++)R((i*43+7)%479,84+(i%3)*3,4,1,'#cbd6a3');
}
$('boxClose').onclick=close;shade.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===shade)close()});$('boxTabs').onclick=e=>{let b=e.target.closest('[data-boxtab]');if(b){tab=b.dataset.boxtab;render()}};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(shade.classList.contains('open')&&e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();close()}});
$('floatingBox').onclick=()=>{window.PastureShop?.close?.();open(true)};$('offlineBox').onclick=()=>open(true);paint();applyPrefs();window.PastureBox={attach,open,close,applyPrefs};
})();
</script>
</body></html>
